theorems.name: Submission.mono833_radial_first_variation_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U) (x : Euclidean N) (ρ₀ Λ A t : ℝ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ), V.HasLocallyBoundedFirstVariation → ball x ρ₀ ⊆ U → 0 ≤ Λ → (∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r < ρ₀ → variationMeasure V (closedBall x r) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal Λ * V.weight (closedBall x r)) → ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → Antitone φ → (∀ s : ℝ, s ≤ 1 → φ s = 1) → (∀ s : ℝ, A ^ 2 ≤ s → φ s = 0) → 0 < A → 0 < t → t * A < ρ₀ → |V.firstVariation (fun y ↦ φ (‖y - x‖ ^ 2 / t ^ 2) • (y - x))| ≤ A * Λ * t * ∫ y, φ (‖y - x‖ ^ 2 / t ^ 2) ∂V.weight
